state.description: `none`: the workspace is in no repository (Create Git Repository); `loading`: the first status is being read; `ready`.

generation.description: The status generation after the call: it grows whenever the repository's status changes (the watcher saw `.git/index`, `.git/HEAD`, `.git/refs/` or the working tree change, or a command changed them). eludite.git.status answers with the same number; an answer with an older generation is stale.

branch.description: The checked-out branch's short name (an unborn branch's too); absent when HEAD is detached.

head.description: A full commit id (40 hexadecimal digits).

ahead.description: Outgoing commits: on the branch, not on its upstream.

behind.description: Incoming commits: on the upstream, not on the branch (as of the last fetch).

operation.description: An operation in progress that stopped (a conflict): finish it by staging the resolved files and committing (merge, cherry-pick) or eludite.git.rebase with `continue`, or abort it.

staged.description: Staged Changes: the index against HEAD.

kind.description: What changed: Visual Studio's glyphs in Git Changes, the Workspace window and the document tabs follow it.

old_path.description: A rename's or copy's old path.

unstaged.description: Changes: the working tree against the index (tracked files).

kind.description: What changed: Visual Studio's glyphs in Git Changes, the Workspace window and the document tabs follow it.

old_path.description: A rename's or copy's old path.

untracked.description: New files not in the index (Changes, with an untracked glyph).

ignored.description: With `include_ignored`: ignored files and folders (a folder ends with `/`).

totals.description: How many files each group has, listed or not.

truncated.description: A group listed fewer files than it has (`max_items`).

message.description: Why the status could not be read, when it could not.
